outcome: number of simultaneous and emergency operations
cohort: 160,400 patients who underwent cesarean sections (C-secs), hysterectomies, or adnexectomies at 43 tertiary hospitals in Korea
finding: Implementation of DRGs in Korean tertiary hospitals led to reductions in the length of stay for obstetric and gynecological surgeries without increasing outpatient visits and readmission rates.
mod_finding: The number of simultaneous surgeries requiring expensive operative instruments during hysterectomies decreased after the introduction of DRGs, while colporrhaphy during hysterectomies and adnexectomies or myomectomies during C-secs did not change.
